page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fuit" (both occurrences) and "falsò" are printed with a long-s-like f; I read them as true f, since "suit" is not Latin. "argumētis" has a tilde-like mark over the e, read as printed. "Dallęi" has a hooked e-cedilla form, read as printed. The Greek-style ę in "Dallęi" is uncertain. Page ends mid-word "discu-", continued on the next page. The "VII." in the margin is a section number, not a heading.
